description: Root-keyed conservation for ERC-8312, recomputed from the Drawn event LOG (the complement to the storage-proof cap-conservation lane). The conserved carrier is ONE root-keyed meter: for a pinned (rootId, periodIndex), Σ of the amounts of the ADMITTED Drawn events ≤ the pinned root cap. Edge/node is attribution (a breakdown label on each draw), NEVER the conserved quantity — a per-edge counter treated as the aggregate is the non-conformant counterexample a fan-out/re-delegation walks past the root cap with. Two honest bounds: the claim is asserted only over draws routed through the meter (non-bypassability is the substrate's obligation, not recomputed here); and (rootId, periodIndex) is a stored key, so the predicate is assertable at any observing block with no timestamp replay. Predicate, not number: what conformance pins is the PREDICATE `Σ admitted Drawn for (rootId,periodIndex) ≤ cap` and the ROOT-KEYED method of computing it — a candidate that reproduces the numbers by the wrong method (per-edge max as aggregate) fails the fan-out vector, which is the point.
recompute: admittedSum = Σ { amount : e ∈ log, e.rootId = rootId, e.periodIndex = periodIndex, e.admitted } ; conserves = admittedSum ≤ cap

vectors.name: single-edge-within-cap
vectors.note: One attributed edge draws under the root cap — conserves.

vectors.name: multi-edge-attributed-within-cap
vectors.note: Three edges attribute their draws; the ROOT sum (1400) is the conserved quantity and stays ≤ cap. Attribution is a breakdown, not the meter.

vectors.name: fanout-exceeds-root-cap
vectors.note: THE COUNTEREXAMPLE. Each edge (900/800/700) is individually under the 2000 cap, so a per-edge counter treated as the aggregate would pass all three — but the root-keyed sum is 2400 > cap. Root-keyed conservation correctly reports non-conservation; a per-edge view is the leak the profile closes.

vectors.name: exact-cap-boundary
vectors.note: Sum equals the cap exactly — conserves (the predicate is ≤, not <).

vectors.name: unadmitted-draws-excluded
vectors.note: Only ADMITTED Drawn events count. A rejected/unadmitted draw (1000) is excluded, so the metered sum is 1500 ≤ cap. Admission is the gate; a non-admitted attempt never touches the meter.

vectors.name: period-index-isolation
vectors.note: period-index-as-stored-key. The cap is scoped to (rootId, periodIndex=7); draws in period 8 (5000) are a different meter and are excluded. Only period-7 admitted draws (1800) count.

vectors.name: cross-root-isolation
vectors.note: Conservation is per-ROOT. The cap is root 0x…01's; draws under root 0x…02 (9000) are a different meter and are excluded. Only root-1 admitted draws (1900) count toward root-1's cap.
